key.name: backdrop
key.summary: Dimming of the screen behind the launcher
key.description: none: the desktop stays fully visible; light: slightly dimmed; standard: clearly dimmed.

key.name: animations
key.description: Opening, closing and the list changing height. It never forces animations on: when they are turned off in GNOME, the launcher does not animate either.

key.name: max-results
key.summary: Maximum number of results per provider

key.name: excluded-types
key.summary: File types excluded from file results

key.name: remember-queries
key.summary: Remember the searches that led to opening a result
key.description: Lets the up arrow bring back a previous search. They stay on this computer. Turning it off erases the remembered searches.

key.name: history-generation
key.summary: Incremented by the preferences to ask for the history (usage and searches) to be erased
